name: Head-on target turns to port
description: Head-on encounter. Rule 14 says both vessels should turn to starboard, but the target visibly turns to ITS OWN PORT partway through -- turning to starboard now would be fatal (it would steer own-ship INTO the target's new track). Correct: Rule 2(b)/8 -- depart from the standard rule to avoid immediate danger.
pass_criteria: Own-ship does not turn to starboard once the target's port turn is visible.
